simple.meaning: בַּעַל פְּעוֹר (Baʻal Pᵉʻôwr) is a place-name in the Hebrew text (H1187). BibleIQ follows its 6 occurrences across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This place appears in Numbers, Deuteronomy, Psalms, Hosea, beginning at Numbers 25:3. The surrounding context includes wilderness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to the Hebrew place-name בַּעַל פְּעוֹר (H1187).
simple.whyItMatters: Places in Scripture often connect geography, covenant history, judgment, worship, and movement through the land. BibleIQ keeps the place tied to its actual verse trail.

definitions.full: H1187. Baal Peor מְּעוֺר בַּ֫עַל proper name, masculine Num 25:3 , 5 ; Deut 4:3 (twice in verse); Psa 106:28 ; Hosea 9:10 , Baal of Peor (VB) i.e. worshipped at מְּעוֺר q. v.; or Baal-P. (whence Peor as proper name, of a location); compare Di Num 25:3 Baud Stud. ii. 233 Bae Rel 14, 210 .
